words: The "Expired" or "Invalid" error a player gets when a redeem code will not go through.
A code for Zyra brands in the reload campaign. One claim per player per code.
The list in the Customer Approaching File that shows who is eligible, the assigned code and its status.
The BO screen (Event, Redeem Code, Redeem Code Payout). Status "approved" means the member already claimed it.
The fixed message to the ATL: UID, brand, code entered, error, code assigned in system, issue.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is this an S0403 case?
items: The player is on the eligible list
He cannot redeem his assigned code
He gets "Expired" or "Invalid" (S0403)
tour.done: All three: run the checks before anything else.
tour.notYet: This SOP covers eligible players with an S0403 error only.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Five checks, then decide
items: Find the record
Redeem Code File in the Customer Approaching File. Search Username or UID.
Verify the customer
UID correct, correct account, correct brand. All three must match.
Verify the code
The code entered matches the code assigned in the system.
Read the status
Claimed: already claimed. Expired: check whether it has actually expired.
Check the BO
Event, Redeem Code, Redeem Code Payout. Enter the code. "Approved" means already claimed.
Escalate only if all 4
Eligible, correct code, not claimed, still S0403: ATL, with the template.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Three hard stops
items: Conclude a code is expired from the error alone.
Escalate before all five verification steps are done.
Escalate unless all four criteria are confirmed.

tour.label: Criteria
tour.title: Escalate only when all four are true
items: Customer is eligible
Correct redeem code
Code is not claimed
System still shows S0403 (Invalid or Expired)
tour.done: All four: send the escalation template to the ATL.
tour.notYet: Any one missing: resolve it at the CS step (wrong code, not eligible, or already claimed).

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: Does this go to the ATL?
tour.q: Are all four criteria confirmed after the five checks?
tour.yes: Escalate to the ATL in Lark with the template: UID, brand, code entered, error, code assigned in system, issue.
tour.no: Resolve at CS. The ATL step is for confirmed faults only.

pool.q: In Redeem Code Payout, the player's code shows status "approved". What does it mean?
o: He already claimed it; resolve at CS
pool.why: Step 5: status "approved" means the member already claimed it.

pool.q: The code the player typed is not the code assigned to him. What now?
pool.why: Step 3: the entered code must match the assigned code. A wrong code resolves at the CS step.

pool.q: A player sends a screenshot of the S0403 error. You have not checked anything yet. What do you do?
o: Run the checks first; the error alone proves nothing
Escalate the screenshot to the ATL
pool.why: Golden Rules: do not conclude a code is expired from the error alone.

o: The Redeem Code File in the Customer Approaching File, by Username or UID
pool.why: Step 1: locate the record in the Redeem Code File before anything else.

pool.q: Eligible, correct code, not claimed, and the system still shows S0403. What now?
o: Escalate to the ATL with the escalation template
pool.why: All four criteria confirmed: escalate to the ATL using the template.

pool.q: The Status field in the Redeem Code File says Expired. What do you do?
o: Tell him it expired and close
Check whether it has actually expired
pool.why: Step 4: Expired means check whether it has actually expired. Read the status, do not assume.

pool.q: The record you found is for the right UID but on a different brand. Escalate?
o: No: UID, account and brand must all match
Yes, if he is Tier V
Ask him which brand he prefers
pool.why: Step 2: UID correct, correct account, correct brand. All three must match.

pool.q: What goes into the escalation to the ATL?
o: UID, brand, code entered, error, code assigned in system, and the issue
pool.why: Section 5: provide all fields of the escalation template.

pool.q: Where in the BO do you check the code?
o: Event, Redeem Code, Redeem Code Payout
pool.why: Step 5: Event, Redeem Code, Redeem Code Payout, then enter the code.

pool.q: Where do most S0403 reports get resolved?
pool.why: Expected outcome: most cases resolve at CS (wrong code, not eligible, or already claimed).
